issues.title: INCIDENT: payments-webhook rollout stuck — captures stopped since Jul 3 14:05 UTC
issues.description: v2.4.1 Deployment is in ImagePullBackOff (tag was never pushed to the registry). No payment captures since the rollout: trips complete, payments stay pending, driver payouts are missing. Support backlog growing. Options: push the tag, or roll back to v2.4.0.

issues.title: Backfill pending payment captures once webhook is restored
issues.description: After OPS-301: replay the capture confirmations for every payment stuck 'pending' (14 and counting — see v_unpaid_completed_trips in the core DB).

issues.title: Alert on payment capture rate, not webhook 200s
issues.description: The webhook being down for 20+ hours before a human noticed means our alert watches the wrong signal. Alert when captures/hour drops to zero while completed trips/hour doesn't.

issues.title: CI: block deploys whose image tag isn't in the registry
issues.description: Root cause of OPS-301 — the pipeline tagged the Deployment before the push step succeeded. Add a registry existence check to the deploy gate.

issues.title: Surge zone soma stuck at 1.8 for 6h
issues.description: Dispatch cache shows soma surging since morning; verify the decay job is running.

comments.body: Confirmed: `kubectl -n rideshare rollout status deploy/payments-webhook` hangs; pod events show ImagePullBackOff on ghcr.io/wheelio/payments-webhook:v2.4.1. The tag does not exist in the registry.
Blast radius query (core DB): SELECT count(*) FROM v_unpaid_completed_trips; -- growing. Support reports driver payout complaints citing TR-1042 and TR-1054.
Release engineering says v2.4.1 CI failed at the push step but the deploy job ran anyway. Fastest fix is rollback to v2.4.0; fix-forward needs a full rebuild.
